markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (93%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class conformal set and clean input [F1], but second model disagrees and neighbor support is weak.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 93%, Normal 4%, InSitu 3% | Clear Benign lead |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 10% error | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / OOD 1.0 | Flag not raised |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Top classes differ |
| Similar cases | 2 of 5 Benign [F5] | Weak neighbor support |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Score well below typical; lowers the concept-model invasive term [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 9, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; associated with lower invasive likelihood [F3] · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Score well below typical; lowers invasive association · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Deleting the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect vs random is 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007), includes 0; not shown to reflect classifier. Normal lobules and mitoses (0/20) are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Input is a degraded resample (severity 3); reliability score ranks errors only modestly (AUROC 0.69).
- Calibration error (ECE) could reach 0.18, so 93% may overstate certainty.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 4, 5, 0:** per-region probe risk 86–90% despite low overall invasive score; confirm benign.
2. **Region 6:** duct-confined atypia peaks here (Weak concept); exclude in-situ.
3. **Regions 1, 9, 10:** confirm true gland formation, not artifact.
